discovery: Development of next-generation DNA sequencing (massively parallel sequencing-by-synthesis using reversible terminator chemistry and clonal cluster amplification)
rationale: Sequencing-by-synthesis rests on chemistry: fluorescent reversible-terminator nucleotides and surface cluster amplification. It cut the cost of genome sequencing by orders of magnitude and changed biology and medicine. It already has major precursor awards, including the 2022 Breakthrough Prize and the 2024 Millennium Technology Prize (2020 for Balasubramanian and Klenerman). The committee has recently rewarded chemistry-enabled tools with broad impact (CRISPR, click chemistry, protein design), and the 2025 MOF prize leaves room to return to chemical biology and biotechnology.
